caption: The drawing features a detailed depiction of a metal mechanism consisting of two large, symmetrical, curved arms each with a pointed fork at the top, riveted connections, and a cog-like gear attached to the outer sides. The two arms are joined in the middle by a rounded plate with visible rivets. Below this central piece, a straight metal bar extends vertically downward, ending in another segment secured to a horizontal metal strip, depicted with bolts or rivets attaching it to a flat surface. Above the main mechanism, there are two smaller line drawings: one is a front elevation showing the mechanism attached to a rectangular structure with decorative scrollwork, while the other is a side elevation showing the mechanism's profile and its attachment. A small scale is present between these two diagrams. The entire drawing is executed in monochrome shades of grey and black, centered on a lightly yellowed, rectangular background.
title: Hinges and Hasp on a Conestoga Wagon Tool Box
